translationRepairs: He and his cousin Zheng Yin both lived in Zhaoguo ward—Yin to the south and Yuqing to the north—whence people spoke of "the southern Zheng minister" and "the northern Zheng minister."
He and his paternal uncle Zheng Yin both lived in Zhaoguo ward—Yin to the south and Yuqing to the north—whence people spoke of "the southern Zheng minister" and "the northern Zheng minister."
從父 means a paternal uncle (father's brother or cousin), not a cousin.

Li Keyong, however, judged Taiyuan vulnerable. He led Shatuo troops in a sudden incursion and camped east of the Fen, claiming he came to fight bandits while making incessant demands.
須索繁仍 means making repeated demands; there is no person named Fan Ning in the source.

朱子奢 is romanized Zhu Zishe; 奢 is read she, not shuo.

Zheng Yin, styled Wenming, belonged to the generation of Yuqing's paternal uncles.
從父行 means Zheng Yin ranked in the generation of Yuqing's father (a paternal-uncle-generation kinsman), not a younger branch.
